metadata.title: Documentation corresponds to the live CLIs (ADR-167)

rules.statement: The generated CLI reference pages (docs/reference/core-admin.md, docs/reference/core.md) MUST equal what the shared reference builder renders from the live core-admin tree and the installed released core-cli. Where core-cli is not installed the core page is not compared and a finding says so; the rule never passes with the comparison skipped.
rules.rationale: ADR-167 D1/D2. CLI to docs direction: the generated reference lists every visible command, so a current reference means no command is undocumented. Remedy: core-admin docs generate --write.

rules.statement: Every `core-admin <group> <command>` or `core <group> <command>` mentioned inside a code span or fenced code block in docs/ (excluding the generated docs/reference/) or in a listed extra path MUST resolve to a live, visible command. core-admin mentions resolve against the live tree; core mentions against the committed docs/reference/core.md. Strings listed in allow_mentions are exempt.
rules.rationale: ADR-167 D1/D3. Docs to CLI direction: docs drifted to ~25 commands that did not exist where documented. A mention of a hidden (deprecated) core-admin alias is a finding too: it exists, but a reader should not copy it.
